prompt: Make a board with one section titled "Allergen Watchlist" holding six yellow sticky notes in two rows: Peanut, Tree nut, Sesame, Shellfish, Soy, Mustard.

Draw a flowchart for a library hold: a terminator "Hold placed", a process "Check shelf", a decision "On shelf?", then a process "Pull and notify" off the yes branch and a process "Request from branch library" off the no branch, ending in a terminator "Hold ready". Label the decision arrows yes and no.

Build a data pipeline diagram left to right using engineering shapes: a file shape "sensor_dump.csv", a queue shape "ingest-queue", a process shape "Normalize units", a database shape "readings_db" and a folder shape "Monthly archives", joined by arrows in that order.
A board for a community garden planning session with three pages: "Plot Map", "Planting Calendar" and "Volunteer Roles". Put a heading text and two stickies on each page.

Put a sticky reading "Night sky unit" in the middle of the page and five stickies around it saying Moon phases, Constellations, Light pollution, Telescopes and Meteor showers, with a line from the middle sticky to every one of them.

Two process boxes, "Draft contract" at the top and "Legal review" below it, joined by a solid elbowed arrow, plus a dashed elbowed arrow going back up from "Legal review" to "Draft contract" labelled "revisions".
Place a sticky "Harbour" at x 0 y 0 and a sticky "Lighthouse" at x 900 y 0, and join them with a curved arrow that is routed through the points (300, -250) and (600, -250).
Three idea stickies in a row — "Longer lunch break", "Standing desks", "Friday demo hour" — and under each one put a thumbs-up reaction stamp, with a heart stamp under "Standing desks" as well.

Make a recognition board: a star shape saying "Top Volunteer", a shield shape saying "Safety Streak 90 Days" and a speech bubble saying "Nice work, trail crew!", arranged side by side across the top of the page.
Lay out four rectangles by coordinates: "Reception" at x 0 y 0, "Exam Room 1" at x 400 y 0, "Exam Room 2" at x 400 y 300, and "Supply Closet" at x 0 y 300, each 320 wide and 220 tall.
A board with three stickies in a row: "Blocked" in red, "At risk" in orange and "On track" in green, and beneath them a grey rectangle saying "Legend" with a black outline at 50% opacity.
A single page with free text "Watershed Field Trip" in large type at the top, "Saturday, 9am–2pm" in medium type below it, and "Bring boots and a refillable bottle" in small type under that.

A flowchart of a loan application using input/output parallelograms: "Enter applicant details" input/output, then a process "Run credit check", then a decision "Score above 650?", then an input/output "Print approval letter" on yes and an input/output "Print denial notice" on no.
Two rounded rectangles, "Kitchen staff" on the left and "Front of house" on the right, joined by a line with an arrowhead at both ends labelled "ticket updates".

Put a process box "Order received" at x 0 y 0 and a process box "Warehouse pick" at x 0 y 400, and connect them with a straight arrow leaving the bottom side of "Order received" and entering the top side of "Warehouse pick".
A rounded rectangle "Weekly newsletter" on the left with arrows fanning out to four stickies on the right: "Members", "Donors", "Board" and "Press list".

A board with three sections side by side titled "Backlog", "In Progress" and "Shipped"; put the stickies "Rewrite tour script", "Fix gift shop signage" in Backlog, "Audio guide pilot" in In Progress, and "New ticket kiosk", "Members' night" in Shipped.

A two-page board: page "Current Route" with stickies Depot, Stop A, Stop B, Depot joined by arrows in a loop, and page "Proposed Route" with stickies Depot, Stop B, Stop A, Depot joined the same way plus a thumbs-up stamp beside the title text "Saves 12 minutes".

Make a troubleshooting board with a section "Symptoms" holding three blue stickies — "Printer offline", "Jobs stuck in queue", "Error 0x6100" — and a section "Checks" to its right holding a diamond "Cable seated?" and a process "Restart spooler", with a dashed arrow from "Jobs stuck in queue" to "Restart spooler" labelled "try first".
